title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Overview**
Microsoft is building the future of AI-powered work, and the
**Agent 365**
team is at the centre of it. We're looking for a passionate
**Senior Software Engineer**
to help design, build and scale the platform that lets organisations deploy, manage and secure AI agents across the Microsoft Cloud.
  
  
In this role you'll work on large-scale, cloud-native systems that use
**big data, machine learning, natural language processing and search technologies**
to give customers intelligent, secure and reliable agent experiences. You'll work closely with product managers, researchers, security experts and engineering teams around the world to turn complex customer needs into high-quality solutions on
**Azure, Microsoft Entra and Microsoft 365**
.
  
  
Security and trust are at the core of what we build. You'll bring a security-first mindset, apply practices such as threat analysis and penetration testing, and help keep our services resilient and compliant. We value engineers who are curious, take ownership, engage directly with customers and enjoy solving hard problems in a fast-moving, collaborative environment.
  
  
If you're excited by cloud and AI and want to shape how millions of people and organisations work with intelligent agents, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborates with appropriate stakeholders to determine user requirements for a scenario.
* Drives identification of dependencies and the development of design documents for a product, application, service, or platform.
* Creates, implements, optimizes, debugs, refactors, and reuses code to establish and improve performance and maintainability, effectiveness, and return on investment (ROI).
* Leverages subject-matter expertise of product features and partners with appropriate stakeholders (e.g., project managers) to drive a workgroup's project plans, release plans, and work items.
* Acts as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI) and guides other engineers by developing and following the playbook, working on call to monitor system/product/service for degradation, downtime, or interruptions, alerting stakeholders about status and initiates actions to restore system/product/service for simple and complex problems when appropriate.
* Proactively seeks new knowledge and adapts to new trends, technical solutions, and patterns that will improve the availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, and performance of products while also driving consistency in monitoring and operations at scale.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's and/or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of professional software development experience.
* Hands-on experience with C++ and/or C#, along with exposure to big data, machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP) and search technologies.
* Strong analytical skills, with experience in customer engagement and cross-functional collaboration.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Cloud services (Azure, Microsoft Entra, Microsoft 365).
* Security awareness, including penetration testing and threat analysis.

**Other Requirements**
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These include, but are not limited to, the following specialised security screening:
  
  

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position requires passing the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A technical software engineer with a passion for cloud technologies and AI.
* Previous experience as a Software Development Engineer.
* Track record of working closely with agile, diverse engineering teams.
* Understanding of cloud, AI and other computing technologies, including business drivers and emerging trends across Microsoft and non-Microsoft technologies.
* Experience working in geographically distributed teams.
* Self-starter who enjoys tackling new challenges and working independently.
* Ability to build relationships with senior technical and business leaders.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including fluency in English.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**About Us:**

Deep22 is a venture-backed, New York-based AI startup building the next generation of video technology for sports and media. Our platform uses AI to help rights holders, broadcasters, and content teams identify, create, and distribute the moments that matter instantly and at scale.

We are passionate about the intersection of sports, media, and technology, and are looking for an exceptional Full Stack Engineer to join our growing engineering team and help bring our vision to life.

**Job Description:**

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer with 2–3 years of experience building and maintaining production software systems.

You will work across our frontend and backend applications and help develop products that process and deliver video at scale. This is a hands-on engineering role where you will work closely with our Lead Software Engineer and founding team, take ownership of meaningful product features, and contribute across the development lifecycle, from implementation and testing through deployment and production support.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys solving challenging engineering problems, wants significant ownership early in their career, and is excited by the opportunity to build at the intersection of AI, video, and sports.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Design, build, and maintain frontend and backend components of our web application using React, TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, and Python.
* Own product features from implementation through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
* Build and maintain APIs and services supporting video processing, content management, user workflows, and data handling.
* Integrate AI and machine learning services into production product workflows.
* Help build reliable, high-performance video ingestion, processing, streaming, and encoding workflows.
* Work with real-time and high-throughput systems that process live and recorded video.
* Build and maintain cloud infrastructure and services on GCP.
* Monitor production systems, investigate issues, and troubleshoot problems across the stack.
* Optimize application performance, reliability, and scalability as usage grows.
* Contribute to CI/CD, testing, observability, and engineering best practices.
* Collaborate closely with engineers, founders, and product stakeholders to translate product requirements into reliable software.
* Take real ownership of what you build and proactively identify opportunities to improve our product and engineering systems.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 2–3 years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining production systems.
* Strong fundamentals in TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, and React.
* Experience building both frontend and backend applications in a production environment.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure and services, ideally Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or an equivalent platform such as AWS or Azure.
* Strong understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, and modern web application architecture.
* Experience deploying, monitoring, and debugging production software.
* Solid debugging instincts and the ability to reason through production issues under pressure.
* Comfort working in a small, fast-moving team where you are expected to take meaningful ownership of what you build.
* Familiarity with Python and an interest in working with AI/ML-powered applications.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong communication skills and a willingness to learn quickly.
* An interest in sports, media, AI, or video technology.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with FFmpeg or other video/media processing tools.
* Experience with real-time or high-throughput data pipelines.
* Familiarity with video streaming protocols such as RTMP, SRT, HLS, or DASH.
* Experience with Docker and containerized applications.
* Experience with serverless or microservices architectures.
* Familiarity with authentication and authorization systems such as OAuth, JWT, or SSO.
* Experience integrating AI/ML models or APIs into production applications.
* Familiarity with computer vision, multimodal AI, or video understanding systems.
* Experience working at an early-stage startup.

**What We Offer:**

* The opportunity to build cutting-edge AI and video products used in professional sports and media.
* Meaningful ownership of production systems and product features from day one.
* The chance to work closely with an experienced founding and engineering team in an early-stage startup environment.
* Significant learning opportunities across full-stack development, cloud infrastructure, AI, and video technology.
* Potential for rapid career growth as the company and engineering team scale.
* Competitive salary and equity.
* Opportunity for domestic and international travel.

title: Lead Systems Engineer - Infra Reliability Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title**
***–***
Lead Systems Engineer
  
  
The Infrastructure Reliability Engineer position will use automation, Infrastructure as Code, observability, operational data, and engineering practices to improve the availability and resiliency of infrastructure services.
  
  
**The Purpose of This Role**
Fidelity’s Enterprise Infrastructure & Operations Distributed Compute and Storage organization is looking for an Infrastructure Reliability Engineer to help engineer, automate, and improve the reliability of our enterprise infrastructure platforms.
  
  
We are a dynamic team of engineers focused on making infrastructure highly available, resilient, observable, automated, and easy to consume. We partner closely with infrastructure engineering, operations, application, cloud, and technology teams to improve platform reliability while reducing operational complexity through automation.
  
  
**The Value You Deliver**
This role will help us move from traditional infrastructure operations toward engineering-led operations, where repetitive activities are automated, infrastructure health is measurable, failures are anticipated, recovery is engineered and tested, and operational insights drive continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Engineer and operate resilient enterprise infrastructure services across on-premises and cloud environments.
* Develop automation that improves infrastructure reliability, scalability, supportability, and operational efficiency.
* Automate common operational activities and eliminate repetitive manual processes.
* Build observability capabilities that provide meaningful insight into infrastructure health and service reliability.
* Partner with Compute, Storage, Cloud, Network, Security, and Application Engineering teams to resolve complex infrastructure problems.
* Participate in major incident response and provide engineering expertise during infrastructure service disruptions.
* Conduct post-incident analysis and convert lessons learned into automation, monitoring, resiliency, or platform improvements.
* Improve infrastructure patching, maintenance, provisioning, lifecycle management, and recovery through automation.
* Participate in capacity planning and proactively identify scalability or performance constraints.
* Engineer and test backup, recovery, and disaster recovery capabilities.
* Develop reusable automation and self-service capabilities for infrastructure consumers.
* Contribute to technical standards, engineering best practices, documentation, and operational procedures.
* Challenge existing operational processes and identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and engineer away operational toil.

**How Your Work Impacts The Organization**
Improve stability, increase availability, and enhance customer and stakeholder satisfaction
  
  
**The Skill that are Key to this role**
**Technical/Behavioral**
**Reliability Engineering**

* Apply reliability engineering principles to improve the availability, resiliency, performance, recoverability, and operational readiness of infrastructure platforms.
* Identify reliability risks and engineer solutions that eliminate or reduce recurring infrastructure failures.
* Establish meaningful health indicators, operational metrics, dashboards, alerts, and reliability measures for infrastructure services.
* Use operational data and production insights to identify patterns and proactively address potential reliability issues.
* Participate in reliability reviews, failure analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Promote blameless root cause analysis and translate incident learnings into engineering improvements.

**Infrastructure Automation**

* Engineer automation that reduces repetitive manual activities and operational toil.
* Develop reusable automation utilizing technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Shell, Golang, Ansible, Terraform, APIs, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, validation, maintenance, recovery, and operational workflows.
* Integrate infrastructure platforms through REST APIs and automation frameworks.
* Apply software engineering disciplines including source control, code reviews, automated testing, reusable components, and CI/CD to infrastructure automation.
* Identify opportunities to transition infrastructure activities from ticket-driven operations to automated and self-service capabilities.

**Observability & Operational Intelligence**- Build and maintain dashboards, monitoring, logging, and alerting capabilities for infrastructure platforms.
- Develop actionable infrastructure health signals rather than relying solely on threshold-based monitoring.
- Correlate telemetry across infrastructure components to accelerate issue identification and resolution.
- Analyze operational and infrastructure data to identify:

* recurring failures,
* performance bottlenecks,
* capacity risks,
* availability trends,
* automation opportunities,
* reliability improvement opportunities.
* Develop data-driven insights and visualizations using platforms such as Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, Power BI, or Tableau.

**Resiliency, Backup & Recovery**

* Engineer infrastructure platforms with recoverability as a core design principle.
* Support enterprise backup and recovery capabilities across compute, storage, virtualization, cloud, and application infrastructure.
* Automate backup validation and recovery workflows to improve consistency and reduce recovery time.
* Participate in disaster recovery and resiliency exercises, including recovery into alternate or newly established infrastructure environments.
* Validate that infrastructure recovery processes meet defined recovery objectives.
* Identify opportunities to continuously improve Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) capabilities.
* Use automation and testing to demonstrate that recovery capabilities work when required rather than relying solely on documented procedures.

**Soft skills required:**
Organizational agility, communications, influencing, time management, contextual awareness and ability to work under pressure.
  
  
**The Expertise We're Looking For**
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with several of the following:
  
  
**Infrastructure**

* Linux / Unix
* Windows Server
* VMware / Virtualization
* Enterprise Compute
* Enterprise Storage
* Kubernetes / Container Platforms
* Backup & Recovery technologies

**Cloud**

* AWS
* Azure
* Private / Hybrid Cloud

**Automation & Infrastructure as Code**

* Python
* PowerShell
* Go Lang
* Shell scripting
* Ansible
* Terraform
* REST APIs

**Observability**

* Datadog
* Splunk
* Prometheus
* Grafana
* ELK / OpenSearch
* OpenTelemetry

**DevOps / Engineering**

* Git
* Jenkins
* CI/CD
* Agile engineering practices
* Automated testing

**Behaviours**

* Systems-thinking and engineering mindset when approaching complex infrastructure and reliability challenges.
* Curiosity and discipline in understanding root causes, with a focus on preventing recurrence rather than only restoring service.
* Automation-first mindset, continuously identifying opportunities to eliminate repetitive operational work and reduce manual effort.
* Strong problem-solving capabilities across complex, interconnected infrastructure technologies and services.
* Data-driven decision making, using telemetry, operational insights, and trends to identify and prioritize reliability improvements.
* Strong understanding of reliability principles, including availability, resiliency, recoverability, observability, scalability, and operational simplicity.
* Effective collaboration across infrastructure, engineering, operations, application, cloud, and technology teams.
* Clear communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ownership and accountability, with a strong focus on delivering outcomes and driving continuous improvement.
* Commitment to engineering excellence, with an emphasis on automation, standardization, simplification, and sustainable operational practices.
